project.title: Pokedex
project.tagline: A Flutter PokéAPI explorer using Clean Architecture, Riverpod, Dio, and multiple browse strategies.

summary.short: flutter_pokedex is a Flutter Pokédex explorer covering Pokémon, items, abilities, moves, berries, types, species, evolution chains, and locations with searchable paged browsing and detail screens.
summary.long: The app uses Clean Architecture with Riverpod and Dio, supports pagination, lazy loading, and infinite scroll, and can switch the Pokémon flow between PokéAPI REST and a GraphQL Pokémon source while keeping category-specific data logic in the repository and data layers.

highlights: PokéAPI REST and Pokémon GraphQL sources
Pagination, lazy loading, and infinite scroll
Reusable list and detail flows across many categories
